question: National Highway No. 7 connects:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Fazilka to Mana.**__

__
 
• **NH 7 **connects **Dehradun, Rishikesh, Devaprayag, Rudraprayag, Karnaprayag, Chamoli, Badrinath, Mana at the Indo/Tibet border** in the state of Uttarakhand.
 
• It includes** Fazilka (Punjab)to Mana (Uttarakhand).**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• India's biggest national highway from **Kashmir to Kanyakumari NH-44** passes through Lalitpur, connecting major cities of India.
 
• **National Highway 27 (NH 27),** an East-West National highway in India that starts from Porbandar and terminates in Silchar, the highway passes through the states of Gujarat, Rajasthan, Madhya Pradesh, Uttar Pradesh (Kanpur), Bihar, West Bengal, Assam.
